name: Kho ca loc
summary: Dried snakehead from the Đồng Tháp Mười side of the province, sunned 3 to 4 days until the flesh is yellow-brown, firm, and still springy. The sweetness is the field fish, under a cure of salt, sugar, MSG, pepper, and chili.
origin: Đồng Tháp Mười, along kênh 79, in the old Long An half of Tây Ninh.
texture: About 3 to 4 kg of fresh fish make 1 kg dried. A piece that is soft or wet has not had enough sun.
taste: The sweetness of field fish, under salt, sugar, MSG, pepper, and chili. Each house has its own mix.
howToEat: Buy it whole or shredded to carry home, or eat it as gỏi xoài, fried with mắm me, tossed with sầu đâu leaves, or in a sour soup.
where: Kênh 79, chợ Bình Hiệp, Bàu Sậy, Gò Châu Mai, khu phố Rọc Chanh, and chợ Tân Hưng, plus orchard and countryside tourism stops.
seoTitle: Kho ca loc from Dong Thap Muoi
seoDescription: Dried snakehead from kênh 79, sunned 3 to 4 days, firm and springy, sold whole or shredded.
